configurePresets.name: dev
configurePresets.description: Single build dir; switch config at build time. Run from a VS Developer shell (vcvars) so cl/ninja are on PATH.

configurePresets.name: ci
configurePresets.displayName: CI — like dev but warnings are errors

configurePresets.name: debug-asan
configurePresets.description: Debug with /fsanitize=address; activates the arena poison/unpoison hooks in arena.cpp (G10). Run the full ctest suite under this preset to prove memory safety.
